description: arXiv:2607.10526v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Self-improving personal agents write profiles, memories, and reusable skills that carry over from one chat to the next. Prior works ask whether a model agrees with the user in its next reply. Yet these agents can also write down a claim the user made, and a later chat can read that note back as trusted context. We call this persistent sycophan...
